title: Food & Drink
description: Order, cook, share and refuse food.

questions.sentence: Tamne bhookh lagi che?
options: Ha, mane bhookh lagi che.
Na, mane taras lagi che.
Ha, mane chaa bhaave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, mane bhookh lagi che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am hungry.

questions.sentence: Mane pani joie che.
options: I want some water.
I want some tea.
I am not hungry.
questions.correctAnswer: I want some water.

questions.sentence: Tame shu pio cho?
options: Hu chaa piu chu.
Hu bhaat khau chu.
Mane pani nathi joitu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu chaa piu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I drink tea.

questions.sentence: Hu roj bhaat khau chu.
options: I eat rice every day.
I drink tea every day.
I eat rice today.
questions.correctAnswer: I eat rice every day.

questions.sentence: Tamne chaa joie che?
options: Ha, mane chaa joie che.
Na, mane bhaat joie che.
Ha, hu ghare jau chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, mane chaa joie che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I would like some tea.

questions.sentence: Mane taras lagi che.
options: I am thirsty.
I am hungry.
I am eating.
questions.correctAnswer: I am thirsty.

questions.sentence: Chaa garam che, dhyaan rakhjo.
options: Saru, hu dhyaan rakhish.
Ha, mane taras lagi che.
Na, hu bhaat khau chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Saru, hu dhyaan rakhish.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, I will be careful.

questions.sentence: Thodu pani aapo.
options: Please give me a little water.
Please give me a little tea.
Please give me some rice.
questions.correctAnswer: Please give me a little water.

questions.sentence: Tu bhaat khaish ke rotli?
options: Hu bhaat khaish.
Hu pani piu chu.
Mane bhookh nathi lagi.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu bhaat khaish.
questions.translatedSentence: I will have rice.

questions.sentence: Bolo, tamne shu joie che?
options: Mane be chaa joie che.
Mane kai nathi joitu, aabhar.
Hu ahiya kaam karu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane be chaa joie che.
questions.translatedSentence: I would like two teas.

questions.sentence: Ek chaa ane be thepla aapo.
options: Please give me one tea and two theplas.
Please give me two teas and one thepla.
Please give me one tea and one dhokla.
questions.correctAnswer: Please give me one tea and two theplas.

questions.sentence: Chaa ma khaand ketli nakhu?
options: Thodi khaand nakho, vadhare nahi.
Khaand na nakho, mane fiki chaa bhaave che.
Be chaa ane ek dhokla aapo.
questions.correctAnswer: Thodi khaand nakho, vadhare nahi.
questions.translatedSentence: Put in a little sugar, not too much.

questions.sentence: Aa dhokla taja che?
options: Is this dhokla fresh?
Is this dhokla sweet?
Is this tea hot?
questions.correctAnswer: Is this dhokla fresh?

questions.sentence: Badha na ketla rupiya thaya?
options: Chalis rupiya thaya.
Mane be chaa joie che.
Hu atyare kai nathi khato.
questions.correctAnswer: Chalis rupiya thaya.
questions.translatedSentence: That comes to forty rupees.

questions.sentence: Aa chaas na ketla rupiya che?
options: How much does this chaas cost?
How much does this tea cost?
Is this chaas cold enough?
questions.correctAnswer: How much does this chaas cost?

questions.sentence: Chaa ahiya piso ke saathe lai jaso?
options: Hu ahiya j piish.
Saathe lai jaish, mane modu thay che.
Mane chaa nahi, pani joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu ahiya j piish.
questions.translatedSentence: I will drink it right here.

questions.sentence: Bija be thepla packet ma aapo.
options: Please put two more theplas in a packet.
Please put two more dhoklas in a packet.
Please give me two more teas to take away.
questions.correctAnswer: Please put two more theplas in a packet.

questions.sentence: Tamari pase chhutta rupiya che?
options: Ha, mari pase chhutta che.
Na, mari pase fakt moti note che.
Ha, mane chaa bahu bhaave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, mari pase chhutta che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have change.

questions.sentence: Shaak kevu lagyu?
options: Shaak bahu saras hatu, pan thodu tikhu hatu.
Shaak hajee banyu nathi, thodi vaar lagse.
Mane shaak nathi joitu, aabhar.
questions.correctAnswer: Shaak bahu saras hatu, pan thodu tikhu hatu.
questions.translatedSentence: The curry was very good, but a little spicy.

questions.sentence: Aa dal bahu tikhi che.
options: This dal is very spicy.
This dal is very sweet.
This dal is a little salty.
questions.correctAnswer: This dal is very spicy.

questions.sentence: Shaak ma mari vadhare nakhu?
options: Na, mane vadhare tikhu nathi bhaavtu.
Ha, aa dal bahu mithi thai gai che.
Na, chaa ma khaand na nakho.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, mane vadhare tikhu nathi bhaavtu.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I don't like it too spicy.

questions.sentence: Chaa bahu garam che, thodi vaar thandi thava do.
options: The tea is very hot, let it cool for a while.
The tea is very sweet, add a little milk.
The tea has gone cold, please heat it again.
questions.correctAnswer: The tea is very hot, let it cool for a while.

questions.sentence: Aa mithai ketli mithi che!
options: Ha, mara mate to aa bahu j mithi che.
Na, aa shaak thodu khaaru che.
Ha, chaa ma khaand ochi che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, mara mate to aa bahu j mithi che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, for me this is far too sweet.

questions.sentence: Mith thodu vadhare padi gayu che.
options: A little too much salt has gone in.
A little too much sugar has gone in.
There is not enough salt in it.
questions.correctAnswer: A little too much salt has gone in.

questions.sentence: Aa chaa ma khaand nakhi che?
options: Ha, thodi khaand nakhi che.
Ha, chaa ma masalo vadhare che.
Na, mane fiki chaa bhaave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, thodi khaand nakhi che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, a little sugar has been put in.

questions.sentence: Mane khaaru khavanu bahu nathi bhaavtu.
options: I don't much like salty food.
I don't much like sweet food.
I like salty food very much.
questions.correctAnswer: I don't much like salty food.

questions.sentence: Mara thi aatlu tikhu khavaay em nathi, shu karu?
options: Thodu dahi ke chaas pi lo, saru lagse.
Vadhare mari nakhi do, swaad aavse.
Chaa garam kari lo, pachhi khaao.
questions.correctAnswer: Thodu dahi ke chaas pi lo, saru lagse.
questions.translatedSentence: Have a little yogurt or chaas, you will feel better.

questions.sentence: Tame ketla jan cho?
options: Ame tran jan chie.
Ame ahiya pehli vaar aavya chie.
Amne bill aapo, ame jaie chie.
questions.correctAnswer: Ame tran jan chie.
questions.translatedSentence: There are three of us.

questions.sentence: Menu laavo ne, ame order aapva mangie chie.
options: Please bring the menu, we would like to order.
Please bring the bill, we would like to leave.
Please bring water, we would like to order.
questions.correctAnswer: Please bring the menu, we would like to order.

questions.sentence: Aaje thali ma shu shu male che?
options: Dal, bhaat, rotli ane be shaak male che.
Thali sava so rupiya ni che.
Ha, thali ma jain khavanu pan male che.
questions.correctAnswer: Dal, bhaat, rotli ane be shaak male che.
questions.translatedSentence: You get dal, rice, roti and two vegetable dishes.

questions.sentence: Amne thodu vadhare pani ane ek khaali plate aapsho?
options: Could you give us a little more water and an empty plate?
Could you give us a little more rice and an empty glass?
Could you bring us the bill and an empty plate?
questions.correctAnswer: Could you give us a little more water and an empty plate?

questions.sentence: Aa shaak ma shu shu nakhyu che?
options: Aa ma bataka, tameta ane thoda masala che.
Aa shaak sava so rupiya nu che.
Ha, aa shaak hajee garam che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aa ma bataka, tameta ane thoda masala che.
questions.translatedSentence: It has potatoes, tomatoes and a few spices in it.

questions.sentence: Rasoi ma thi khavanu aavva ma ketli vaar lagse?
options: How long will the food take to come from the kitchen?
How long will the tea take to come from the kitchen?
How much will the food from the kitchen cost?
questions.correctAnswer: How long will the food take to come from the kitchen?

questions.sentence: Jamvanu kevu hatu, saheb?
options: Badhu bahu swaadisht hatu, aabhar.
Ha, ame ahiya pehli vaar aavya chie.
Na, amne hajee menu nathi malyu.
questions.correctAnswer: Badhu bahu swaadisht hatu, aabhar.
questions.translatedSentence: Everything was delicious, thank you.

questions.sentence: Bill lai aavo, ane saathe thoda chhutta paisa laavjo.
options: Please bring the bill, and bring some change with it.
Please bring the menu, and bring some water with it.
Please bring the bill, and bring some more tea with it.
questions.correctAnswer: Please bring the bill, and bring some change with it.

questions.sentence: Paisa kevi rite aapso, cash ke online?
options: Hu online payment kari daish.
Bill tran so rupiya thayu che.
Amne aa table barabar nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu online payment kari daish.
questions.translatedSentence: I will pay online.

questions.sentence: Aaje raat na jamvaa ma shu banavvu che?
options: Aaje khichdi ane kadhi banavie.
Aaje ame bahar jami lidhu hatu.
Ha, mane bahu bhookh lagi che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aaje khichdi ane kadhi banavie.
questions.translatedSentence: Let's make khichdi and kadhi today.

questions.sentence: Tu mane thodi dungli sudhaari aap.
options: Chop some onion for me.
Chop some tomatoes for me.
Bring some onions for me.
questions.correctAnswer: Chop some onion for me.

questions.sentence: Hu tamne rasoi ma shu madad karu?
options: Tu bhaat mate pani mooki de.
Hu rasoi ma kadi kaam nathi karto.
Ha, mane rasoi karvi bahu bhaave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Tu bhaat mate pani mooki de.
questions.translatedSentence: Put the water on for the rice.

questions.sentence: Dal ma mith nakhvanu bhuli na jato.
options: Don't forget to put salt in the dal.
Don't forget to put sugar in the tea.
Don't forget to put salt in the rice.
questions.correctAnswer: Don't forget to put salt in the dal.

questions.sentence: Shaak ma tel ketlu nakhu?
options: Bahu ochu tel nakh, ame telvalu khavanu ochu khaie chie.
Shaak ma dungli pan nakhi de.
Gas bandh kari de, shaak thai gayu che.
questions.correctAnswer: Bahu ochu tel nakh, ame telvalu khavanu ochu khaie chie.
questions.translatedSentence: Use very little oil, we don't eat much oily food.

questions.sentence: Rotli banavtaa pehla lot baandhi le.
options: Knead the dough before you make the rotlis.
Wash the rice before you make the khichdi.
Heat the oil before you make the rotlis.
questions.correctAnswer: Knead the dough before you make the rotlis.

questions.sentence: Khichdi thai gai ke hajee vaar che?
options: Thai gai, have gas bandh kari de.
Mein hajee lot nathi baandhyo.
Mane khichdi ane kadhi bahu bhaave che.
questions.correctAnswer: Thai gai, have gas bandh kari de.
questions.translatedSentence: It's done, you can turn off the gas now.

questions.sentence: Jamva besie te pehla badha ne bolavi lo.
options: Call everyone before we sit down to eat.
Serve everyone after we sit down to eat.
Call everyone before we make the food.
questions.correctAnswer: Call everyone before we sit down to eat.

questions.sentence: Hu vasan dhoi naakhu?
options: Na rehva de, hu pachhi dhoi naakhish.
Ha, khichdi ma mith barabar che.
Na, aaje ame bahar jamishu.
questions.correctAnswer: Na rehva de, hu pachhi dhoi naakhish.
questions.translatedSentence: Leave them, I will wash them later.

questions.sentence: Tame shaakahari cho ke mansahari?
options: Hu shaakahari chu, etle mara mate shaak ane dal chalse.
Mane tikhu khavanu bahu bhaave che, pan aaje nahi.
Hu roj chaa piu chu, pan doodh vagar ni.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu shaakahari chu, etle mara mate shaak ane dal chalse.
questions.translatedSentence: I am vegetarian, so vegetables and dal will do for me.

questions.sentence: Mane dungli ane lasan nathi chaltu, kem ke ame jain chie.
options: I can't have onion or garlic, because we are Jain.
I don't like onion or garlic, but I do eat them sometimes.
We are Jain, so we don't eat anything after sunset.
questions.correctAnswer: I can't have onion or garlic, because we are Jain.

questions.sentence: Aa mithai ma badam che? Mane badam ni allergy che.
options: Ha, aa ma badam che, etle tame na khaso.
Na, aa mithai bahu mithi nathi, tame khai sako.
Ha, aa mithai Ahmedabad thi aavi che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, aa ma badam che, etle tame na khaso.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, it has almonds in it, so please don't eat it.

questions.sentence: Jo bahu tikhu na hoy to hu jarur chakhish.
options: If it isn't too spicy, I will definitely try it.
If it is too spicy, I won't eat it at all.
Even if it is spicy, I will definitely try it.
questions.correctAnswer: If it isn't too spicy, I will definitely try it.

questions.sentence: Gujarati khavanu ma tamne sauthi vadhare shu bhaave che?
options: Mane undhiyu sauthi vadhare bhaave che, khaas kari ne shiyala ma.
Hu Surat ma be varas rahyo hato, saru shaher che.
Mane khavanu banavtaa barabar nathi aavadtu.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane undhiyu sauthi vadhare bhaave che, khaas kari ne shiyala ma.
questions.translatedSentence: I like undhiyu the most, especially in the winter.

questions.sentence: Pehla hu roj mithai khato hato, pan have hu bahu ochi khau chu.
options: I used to eat sweets every day, but now I eat very few.
I eat sweets every day, and now I eat even more of them.
Earlier I did not eat sweets, but now I eat them every day.
questions.correctAnswer: I used to eat sweets every day, but now I eat very few.

questions.sentence: Tamne doodh vaali chaa chalse ke kaali chaa aapu?
options: Kaali chaa aapo, kem ke mane doodh nathi chaltu.
Chaa rehva do, mane fakt garam pani aapo.
Ha, chaa ma khaand thodi vadhare nakhjo.
questions.correctAnswer: Kaali chaa aapo, kem ke mane doodh nathi chaltu.
questions.translatedSentence: Please give me black tea, because milk doesn't suit me.

questions.sentence: Ame ghare kadi maans nathi banavta, etle mehmano ne pan shaakahari j jamaadie chie.
options: We never cook meat at home, so we serve our guests vegetarian food too.
We rarely cook meat at home, so we ask our guests what they eat.
We do cook meat at home, but our guests only eat vegetarian food.
questions.correctAnswer: We never cook meat at home, so we serve our guests vegetarian food too.

questions.sentence: Kaal ni party ma tamara mate shu banavu?
options: Tame chinta na karo, je hoy te hu khai laish, pan thodu ochu tikhu rakhjo.
Hu kaal ni party ma nahi aavi shaku, kem ke mane kaam che.
Kaal ni party ma jamvanu bahu swaadisht hatu, aabhar.
questions.correctAnswer: Tame chinta na karo, je hoy te hu khai laish, pan thodu ochu tikhu rakhjo.
questions.translatedSentence: Don't worry, I will eat whatever there is, but please keep it a little less spicy.
